body:
So my dealer had not been available for three days. I was losing it. I was resorting to scraping baggies, but that was not helping anymore.
Eventually, I was lucky enough to find a few rocks on the floor that I probably spilled at another time, so I heated up my spoon and got ready to do a little shot. I did it, and started to feel a little rush, but then something went terribly wrong. I fell forward and on to my bed...I knew I was having (another) overdose. I yelled for my friend upstairs to call 911, and thats all I remember, really.
They took me to the intensive care unit and the rest is history. I had not shot up in almost a year, and this is what I get?? Imagine if I did my regular dose with a little dilaudid! I'm happy to be alive!
